notes: Official Jeffco GIS (owner Jeffco). Second test -105.115,39.575 (Ken Caryl) -> P-D. Covers the whole county: inside municipalities ZTYPE is a placeholder 'CONTACT CITY OF <NAME>' / 'CONTACT TOWN OF MORRISON' (seen for Arvada, Bow Mar, Broomfield, Denver, Edgewater, Golden, Lakeside, Lakewood, Littleton, Mountain View, Superior, Westminster, Wheat Ridge, Morrison). Treat ZTYPE LIKE 'CONTACT%' as not county-zoned and route to the city layer. No description field; ZCASE holds the rezoning case number. Layer id is 36, not 0.

City of Lakewood's own ArcGIS Server. Second test -105.0814,39.7110 (Belmar) -> ZONING 'PD/M-C-U', PDNAME 'VILLA ITALIA MOD 3 4 5'. PDNAME is filled only for planned developments; there is no general district-name field, so straight zones need a code-to-name lookup.

Official City of Arvada AGOL org (owner 'arvada'), last edit Oct 2026. Also GEN_ZONING (broad class), DEV_STANDA (standards PDF link), ALLOWED_US (uses page link). Second test -105.0811,39.8003 -> OS 'Parks and Open Space'. Ignore 'ArvadaAllowableZoning' (third-party copy, 2023). 'Land_Use_Plan' in the same org is the comp plan, not zoning.

City of Wheat Ridge AGOL org (owner jtallant@wheatridge.gov), last edit Oct 2026. Newest of several dated copies in the same org (ZoningJan2026 at layer 13, Zoning_02_2024, Wheat_Ridge_Zoning_Districts_October_31_2023). ZoningDesc holds 'code + name'. The old maps.ci.wheatridge.co.us OpenData MapServer returns 404. The service name may change on republish; re-search the org if it 404s.

City of Golden's own server; features edited 2026. Layer id is 25 (layer 0 errors). Second test -105.2050,39.7400 -> R-1 'Residential Standard Lot'. The AGOL copy services1.arcgis.com/FP2GwMAr4SrmXGhq/arcgis/rest/services/Zoning/FeatureServer/0 (2021 edits) has the same fields; use only as a fallback.

City of Edgewater, CO AGOL org (EdgewaterGIS; Edgewater FL uses similar names, so match by URL). Parcel-based: each feature is a Jeffco parcel with zoning attributes joined (test parcel 2501 HARLAN ST). Points in streets return nothing or PIN 'ROW' with blank ZONECODE. ZONING_1 disagrees with ZONECODE on a few parcels (e.g. R-1 with 'Limited Commercial'); trust ZONECODE. ZoneHTML links to the Municode district section. Use outFields=ZONECODE,ZONING_1 (the layer has ~300 assessor fields).

No public layer found. Town of 16 residents (0.25 sq mi: Lakeside Amusement Park, Lake Rhoda, the former Lakeside mall). Jeffco layer returns 'CONTACT CITY OF LAKESIDE'. Fallback: call the Town of Lakeside clerk (www.lakeside.town).

No public layer found. 12-block town (Sheridan to Fenton, W 41st to W 44th Ave). Municipal Code 16.01.080: the official zoning map is kept at Town Hall; districts R-2, R-3, C-1, PD. Jeffco layer returns 'CONTACT CITY OF MOUNTAIN VIEW'. Fallback: https://www.townofmountainviewcolorado.org/town_business_information/town_zoning_map or call Town Hall.

No public queryable layer found. New Title 10 Land Use Code (Ord. 553, 2025-05-20); a 'Morrison Zoning Map 2025' PDF is linked from https://www.morrisonco.us/sitemap. Jeffco layer returns 'CONTACT TOWN OF MORRISON'. Fallback: PDF map or call Morrison planning.

Official Boulder County server. Second test -105.40,40.05 -> F 'Forestry'. Covers the whole county: municipalities are placeholder polygons with ZONECLASS starting 'X' (XBO Boulder, XER Erie, XJA Jamestown, XLA Lafayette, XLG Longmont, XLO Louisville, XLY Lyons, XNE Nederland, XSU Superior, XWA Ward). Treat ZONECLASS LIKE 'X%' as not county-zoned and route to the city layer. REG_PDF_URL links to the Land Use Code article.
City of Boulder's own server (owner BoulderCO). Second test -105.26,40.00 -> BC-2 'Business-Community 2'. ZONINGDISTPURPOSE holds the full district purpose text.

City of Longmont AGOL org. CAVEAT: this is an Oct 2024 zoning-map snapshot (layer edited Mar 2025), not a live city layer. The city's own service (arcgis.domain1.ci.longmont.co.us/arcgis_public/rest/services/Planning/Zoning2021/MapServer) is registered on AGOL but its hostname does not resolve publicly. Layer id is 10 (other layers in the service are parcels, planning area, etc.). Second test -105.13,40.15 -> MUR 'Mixed-Use Regional Center'.

City of Louisville's own server. Second test -105.15,39.965 -> P-R 'Planned Community Residential'. Most subdivisions also carry a PUD overlay held in the separate Planning/PUDs service on the same server; this layer gives only the base district.

City of Lafayette's own portal; it is the zoning layer behind the city's 'Lafayette Zoning Districts' Experience app. CAVEAT: features last edited Sept 2021, and Lafayette has since adopted a rewritten Land Use Code with a new zoning map (PDF at lafayette-listens.com/landusecode), so codes may be pre-rewrite. The city page also says the online map is not the official zoning map. Second test -105.11,39.99 -> R1 'Medium Density Residential District'. 'pud' is a Y/N flag.

Town of Superior's own server; it is the 'Zone Districts' layer in the town's 'Town of Superior Planning' Experience app. Second test -105.16,39.933 -> PD, NAME 'Rock Creek' (NAME holds the PD name). Do NOT use the 'Superior_Zoning_*' services from AGOL owner rmiller_willdan: they are Superior, ARIZONA. A small part of Superior lies in Jefferson County; the Jeffco layer returns 'CONTACT CITY OF SUPERIOR' there.

Town of Erie's own server (OpenData service, layer 8). ZONEDESCRIPTION usually repeats the code, so a code-to-name lookup is needed. DOCLINK links to the PD ordinance in Laserfiche. Erie spans Boulder and Weld counties; the layer covers both parts. Second test -105.07,40.03 -> PD.

No public queryable layer found. The town publishes a Zoning Map PDF plus a 'Zoning Map Updates' PDF at https://www.nederlandco.gov/building-planning-zoning-department/page/zoning; its own how-to guide says to cross-reference the Boulder County parcel viewer with the PDF. Boulder County layer returns XNE here. Fallback: PDF or call Nederland planning.

Town of Lyons AGOL org (owner Lyons_Planning); it is the 'Zone Districts' layer in the town's 'Lyons Citizen GIS Portal' app linked from lyonscolorado.com/170/Zoning-Land-Use. Edited Apr 2026. Gaps exist: test points -105.2711,40.2247 and -105.2700,40.2245 (downtown, likely right-of-way) returned no feature. An older copy, Lyons_Zoning_Map_PublicView, sits in the same org.

Official City and County of Denver open data (owner The_City_and_County_of_Denver), last edit Oct 2026. Cross-check source for the statewide parcel zoningCode. Layer id is 209, not 0. Second test -104.953,39.737 -> U-RH-3A with OVERLAY_DISTRICT UO-3. Also has ZONE_DIST_TYPE, OVERLAY_DISTRICT, PUD_NUM, HEIGHT_STORIES, ADU.
